paragraphs: From Clybaun Galway test centre, exit the Athy Roundabout and take a left onto the Western Distributor Road.
At the small roundabout take a slight left onto Clybaun Road Upper and continue straight for about 445 metres.
Turn left into Rowan Hill.
Take the 1st left into Ros Aitinn and perform a U-turn, keeping your observations sharp before moving off.
Turn right out of Ros Aitinn onto Rowan Hill.
Turn right again onto Clybaun Road Upper.
At the roundabout take the exit onto the Western Distributor Road and continue straight.
Work through the next roundabouts following signs for the Western Distributor Road, taking the slight left exits toward Bishop O'Donnell Road.
At the next roundabout continue straight onto Bishop O'Donnell Road.
Follow the road as it becomes Rahoon Road.
Take a right to stay on Rahoon Road, which becomes Shantalla Road.
Continue on and turn right onto Saint Mary's Road, which flows into Lower Salthill Road.
Turn right onto Upper Salthill Road and complete a U-turn, using your mirrors and blind spot checks carefully.
Head back along Upper Salthill Road and turn left into Lenaboy Gardens.
Take the slight left at the fork onto Oaklands.
At the end of the road turn left onto Dalysfort Road.
At the end of the road turn right onto Upper Salthill Road.
Take a left to stay on Upper Salthill Road.
Turn right into Dún Na Carraige and practice another U-turn.
Turn right at the end of the road back onto Upper Salthill Road.
Follow Upper Salthill Road for just over a kilometre, then turn left onto Barna Road.
Take a right onto Cappagh Road.
Take a left into Liosmór and perform a turnabout.
Rejoin Cappagh Road with a left turn.
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto the Western Distributor Road.
Continue straight through the next roundabout.
Take a right onto Clybaun Road Upper for extra junction practice.
Take a left back onto the Western Distributor Road.
Rejoin the main road at the roundabout.
At the final roundabout take the slight left onto Cappagh Road.
Turn left into Knocknacarra and pass Cappagh Park as you return toward the Clybaun test centre.
